# Sources

Copied from https://github.com/yama6a/subtitle-toolbox-php/tree/c0adecd5375820d5313f1583fc7e67942d514600/tests/files/chapters/youtube/real, MIT. In the rows below, "this repository" means subtitle-toolbox-php.

| File | Source | License |
|:--- |:--- |:--- |
| `video_description.txt` | Written for this repository in the shape of a YouTube video description: text and a link around the chapter list, `-`, en dash and `|` separators, a time at the end of a line | MIT |
| `long_stream_chapters.txt` | Written for this repository in the shape of the chapters of a long live stream: two-digit minutes, times above one hour | MIT |
